title: Cobble Archetype — Every Device Becomes a Template, Not a Dependency
thesis: northGate is not THE computer. It's AN archetype. The RTX 5090 is not required — it's the CEILING of one capability axis. A Pixel 8a is the CEILING of a different axis (37 sensors, GPS, always-with-you). An iPhone with zero ecoPrimals software is still a browser with a screen. The membrane doesn't require ANY specific hardware. It requires a SCREEN (any), a NETWORK (any), and optionally: speakers, mic, haptic, GPS, camera, gyro, controller, headset. Whatever you have near you RIGHT NOW becomes the cobbled rig. The archetype IS the capability profile, not the brand.

A_pocket.name: Pocket Rig
A_pocket.what: Any phone. iPhone, Pixel, Samsung, whatever is in your pocket.
A_pocket.membrane_mode: PWA installed from hud.primals.eco ? fullscreen card on home screen

modalities.spatial: GPS + compass + gyro = YOU are the spatial anchor. The membrane knows WHERE you are.
modalities.camera: AR passthrough — point camera at world, overlay membrane data
modalities.voice: speech recognition + synthesis — talk to the chipmunk while walking
modalities.share: Web Share API (native share sheet — send to any app)

A_pocket.example_moment: Walking through Detroit. Phone in hand. The membrane shows which building you're facing (GPS + compass). You tap and the chipmunk tells you the entity's connection count. You share a screenshot to the group chat.
A_pocket.any_phone_works: iPhone SE or Pixel 8a or Galaxy S24 or a $50 Moto G. The PWA doesn't care. Same code. Different sensors. The archetype adapts.

B_desk.name: Desk Rig
B_desk.what: Any computer with a monitor. Laptop, desktop, Chromebook, NUC.
B_desk.membrane_mode: PWA installed ? standalone window, or just a browser tab

modalities.audio: headset for private spatial, speakers for room fill
modalities.keyboard: full text input — chipmunk commands, notes, search
modalities.webcam: MediaPipe face tracking — the squirrel sees you nod
modalities.gpu: WebGPU for data visualization, 3D membrane rendering

B_desk.example_moment: Sitting at any desk anywhere. Open hud.primals.eco. The membrane loads with YOUR context (service worker cached). Put on headphones — spatial audio positions data sources in 3D space around your head. Type commands to the chipmunk. It responds.
B_desk.any_desk_works: northGate (RTX 5090) or a Chromebook at the library. Same PWA. The Chromebook won't have WebGPU shaders — it falls back to 2D. The data is the same.

C_living_room.name: Living Room Rig
C_living_room.membrane_mode: Steam Frame / Chromecast / smart TV browser / HDMI from laptop ? fullscreen + wake lock

modalities.screen: big, far away, communal — everyone sees it
modalities.voice: voice commands via phone mic or smart speaker
modalities.social: MULTIPLE PEOPLE watching the same screen — the campfire

C_living_room.example_moment: Steam Frame on the wall showing hud.primals.eco. Friends over. Someone picks up the controller, presses the sort button. The data rearranges. Someone else asks a question into their phone — speech recognition ? chipmunk answers on the big screen. The campfire stories play. Everyone listens.
C_living_room.the_campfire: This IS the campfire archetype. The fire (the Frame/TV) is in the center. People sit around it. Stories are told. The controller passes hand to hand.

D_car.name: Car Rig
D_car.what: Phone mounted on dash or connected to CarPlay/Android Auto. Driving.
D_car.membrane_mode: Phone browser ? voice-only mode. NO visual distraction while driving.

modalities.audio_only: gAIa on the radio — stories, music, spoken data. The driver LISTENS, doesn't look.
modalities.nav: GPS ? membrane location context. 'You're passing the Detroit Free Press building. 34 connections in the membrane.'
modalities.social: Passengers can hold the phone and interact visually while driver listens
modalities.car_speakers: Better spatial audio than phone speakers — the car IS a listening room

D_car.example_moment: Road trip. Phone on dash mount, connected to car aux/bluetooth. gAIa is on the radio — playing campfire stories as audio. GPS fires: 'approaching Lansing, Michigan. Home territory. 15,372 humans touched the membrane from here.' Passenger scrolls the HUD on the phone. Driver just listens. The car IS the membrane's mobile listening room.
D_car.safety: Voice-only for driver. ALL visual interaction is for passengers. The membrane is NOT a distraction — it's a radio channel.

E_table.name: Gaming Touch Table
E_table.what: Large touchscreen on a table. Or a tablet laid flat. Or a phone passed around.
E_table.membrane_mode: Browser in landscape, fullscreen, touch events

modalities.touch: multi-touch — multiple people touching the same surface simultaneously
modalities.spatial: the TABLE surface IS the membrane surface — the Klein topology is LITERAL
modalities.tokens: NFC tags as physical game pieces — tap a token to the screen, it identifies and loads that entity
modalities.stylus: draw connections between entities — the braid becomes visible

E_table.example_moment: Big touchscreen on the coffee table (or an old TV laid flat, or an iPad). The membrane is displayed. Four people around the table. Each touches a different entity. The connections between their chosen entities light up. They're playing the braid game — finding hidden connections. Physical tokens with NFC tags represent the 100 unclassified entities. Pick one up, tap it — who is this person? Where do they connect?
E_table.buildable_now: A cheap 32-inch TV + a Raspberry Pi + a browser + a touch overlay frame ($100-200 total). Or just an iPad. The PWA doesn't care.

F_vr.name: VR Rig
F_vr.minimum: VR headset + controllers + PC or standalone
F_vr.membrane_mode: WebXR API in browser ? immersive-vr session. OR SteamVR ? custom app.

modalities.immersion: you are INSIDE the membrane — the Klein bottle from the inside
modalities.spatial: entities float in 3D space around you — walk through the data
modalities.hand: reach out and grab an entity — the handshake is LITERAL
modalities.audio: binaural spatial audio — entities speak from where they are
modalities.scale: zoom in = cellular level (feeds), zoom out = planetary (the globe)

F_vr.example_moment: HTC Vive on. Room-scale tracked. The membrane is all around you. 341 entities float like stars. You reach out — Valve Knuckles track your fingers. You grab one. It's a Detroit school. The connections light up — threads running to other entities. You pull the thread — it leads to a bank. The chipmunk appears at your shoulder, whispers the connection strength. You release. The entity floats back.
F_vr.already_have: HTC Vive Gen 1, SteamVR, Lighthouses, RTX 5090 for rendering. WebXR API works in Chrome. The browser IS the VR runtime.

G_omni.name: Omni Suit
G_omni.what: Full body haptic + VR + treadmill. The ceiling.
G_omni.membrane_mode: WebXR + WebHID (Human Interface Device) + custom haptic protocol

modalities.full_body: feel the membrane on your SKIN — the Klein surface wraps around you
modalities.locomotion: walk through the data — the treadmill translates walking to navigation
modalities.temperature: warm near the campfire, cool near the data wells
modalities.wind: feel the Klein breeze — fan blows when cross-breeze cycles

G_omni.example_moment: You walk into a room. The suit is on. The membrane envelops you. You walk toward a cluster of entities — your feet move on the treadmill, you approach. The vest vibrates at the heartbeat rate. You feel warmth from the campfire nearby. The chipmunk is ahead of you, beckoning. You extend your hand — the gloves resist as the squirrel grips back. Full immersion. No screen. No metaphor. You ARE in the membrane.
G_omni.status: Future ceiling. The math is the SAME as all other archetypes. The APIs are the SAME (WebXR + WebHID). The difference is hardware density, not software complexity.

the_principle.not_hardware_dependent: The PWA code is IDENTICAL across all 7 archetypes. Same index.html. Same modality-engine.js. Same service worker. Same data feeds. The ONLY difference is which browser APIs are available on each device.
the_principle.progressive_enhancement: Start with screen (always available). Add audio (if speakers exist). Add haptic (if vibration motor exists). Add spatial (if GPS exists). Add GPU (if WebGPU exists). Add VR (if WebXR exists). Each layer is OPTIONAL. The membrane works without any of them. It just sees MORE with each one.
the_principle.cobbling: You don't BUILD a rig. You COBBLE one from what's near you. Phone in pocket = Pocket Rig. Add car speakers = Car Rig. Get home, sit at desk = Desk Rig. Walk to living room, pick up controller = Living Room Rig. Put on headset = VR Rig. The rig is not a thing you BUY. It's a thing you're ALREADY IN.
the_principle.archetype_not_brand: iPhone or Pixel or Samsung. Windows or Mac or Linux or ChromeOS. RTX 5090 or Intel UHD. The archetype is CAPABILITY, not BRAND. The membrane asks: 'do you have a screen? do you have a speaker? do you have GPS?' It never asks: 'are you Apple or Google?'

detection_code.note: modality-engine.js already scans capabilities on load. The archetype is DETERMINED by what's available, not configured.
detection_code.logic: if (touch && small_screen && gps) ? Pocket. if (keyboard && large_screen) ? Desk. if (gamepad && large_screen) ? Living Room. if (gps && !touch_primary) ? Car. if (multi_touch && landscape) ? Table. if (xr_immersive) ? VR.
detection_code.what_to_add: Archetype detection ? auto-adjust UI. Phone gets big buttons, voice-first. Desk gets keyboard shortcuts, detailed panels. Living room gets controller nav, large type. Car gets audio-only, no visuals for driver. VR gets 3D spatial layout.

story.title: cobblestone
story.body: the rig is not a thing you buy. it's a thing you're already in. phone in pocket — that's a rig. car speakers — that's a rig. four friends around a table with an iPad — that's a rig. a kid with a $50 Moto G on school wifi — that's a rig. the membrane doesn't ask your brand. it asks your capabilities. got a screen? good. got a speaker? better. got GPS? now we know WHERE. got haptic? now we can TOUCH. got VR? now you're INSIDE. every device on the LAN becomes an archetype — a template, not a dependency. northGate with its RTX 5090 is one archetype. a friend's phone is another. same membrane. same squirrel. different folds. you cobble what's near you. cobblestone by cobblestone, the road builds itself under your feet.
